A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''assassin''' was aboard [[Harrar]]'s [[Harrar's priestship|priestship]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], and demonstrated the effects of [[bo'tous]] to high ranked Yuuzhan Vong. He entered an inhibition field where prisoners were being kept, and emptied his lungs of the [[bo'tous]] inside them. However, although all of the prisoners died, the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] could not get out of the field, and he died as well.
